expected_symptom: Compiling the reporter's ps_6_6/PSMain shader (a static const array of ResourceDescriptorHeap-backed Texture2D objects indexed by NonUniformResourceIndex) fails DXIL validation with 'All metadata must be used by dxil.!<N> = !{i32 <M>}'.
reviewed_by: gpt-5.3-codex (independent batch-019 step-10 review; applied selectively at collation)
summary: Still reproduces on main (89e2f98e2): the DXIL-validation error is unchanged since filing and present on every probeable stable release back to v1.6.2104 (2021-04-20), the oldest release accepting -T ps_6_6 -- no clean release exists anywhere in the checkable history. @tex3d's comment remains the authoritative read: dxc does not legalize this pattern and the intended fix is a diagnostic naming it, which has not landed. Separately, @Keenuts' -spirv isa<> assertion crash no longer reproduces -- it access-violated through v1.8.2403.2 and has failed with an ordinary diagnosed error from v1.8.2405 onward.
text_stale: Comment by @Keenuts (2023-01-03) reports an isa<> assertion crash when '-spirv' is added; this no longer reproduces on any stable release from v1.8.2405 (2024-05-24) onward or on main -- the -spirv path now fails with an ordinary diagnosed error instead of crashing.
title: Dynamic resources validation errors: All metadata must be used by dxil.!55 = !{i32 1}
